decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed commercial-led scheme on a site identified for the delivery of self-contained housing and which has an extant planning permission for housing would fail to comply with policy H1 (Maximising the supply of self-contained housing), Policy H2 (Maximising the supply of self-contained homes from mixed use schemes) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan, Policy 1 (Housing) and Policy 4 (West Hampstead Growth Area) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015 and Policy H1 (Increasing housing supply) and Policy H4 (Delivering affordable housing) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 2 - The proposed development, in the absence of affordable housing, would fail to maximise the supply of affordable homes to meet the needs of households unable to access market housing, contrary to Policy H4 (Maximising the supply of affordable housing) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy H4 (Delivering affordable housing) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 3 - The proposed development by reason of its massing, building line and its relationship to the adjacent public realm would compromise the delivery of spaces that prioritise pedestrians and create a welcoming environment for people to dwell and walk contrary to Policy D1 (Design) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017, Policy 2 (Design and character) and Policy 9 (Pavements and pedestrians) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015 and Policy D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), Policy D4 (Delivering good design) and Policy D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 4 - The proposed development would undermine the ability to delivery comprehensive redevelopment of the O2 masterplan site, the principles of good placemaking which underpin the vision for that neighbourhood and the public benefits which have been secured contrary to Policy D1 (Design), Policy G1 (Delivery and Location of Growth) and Policy 4 (West Hampstead Growth Area) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015, Policy GG2 (Making the best use of land), Policy SD7 (Town Centres: Development Principles and Development Plan Documents), Policy D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), Policy D4 (Delivering good design) and Policy D4 (Public realm) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 5 - In the absence of adequate information on trip generation it is not possible to assess the transport implications of the development and to inform the travel plan which would need to be secured by legal agreement with the associated monitoring and measures contribution, meaning the proposed development is likely to give rise to impacts on transport infrastructure and may not promote the use of sustainable modes of transport and contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T1 (Strategic approach to transport) and Policy T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impact) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 6 - The proposed development, which has 19 car parking spaces, and in the absence of a legal agreement to secure it as a car-free development, would be likely to contribute unacceptably to environmental impacts and traffic congestion in the surrounding area, making the development non-air quality neutral and harm the Borough's transport and public realm infrastructure, contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), Policy T2 (Parking and Car-free), Policy T3 (Transport Infrastructure), Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development), Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring), Policy CC4 (Air Quality) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T1 (Strategic approach to transport), Policy T2 (Healthy Streets), Policy T3 (Transport capacity, connectivity and safeguarding), Policy T6 (Car parking), Policy T6.1 (Residential parking) and Policy SI1 (Improving air quality) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 7 - In the absence of adequate information on servicing arrangements on and off site for the proposed development it would be likely to give rise to conflicts with other road users and be detrimental to the amenities of the area generally as well as conflict with the aspirations to create a gateway to the O2 site where pedestrian and cyclists dominate contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), Policy T3 (Transport Infrastructure), Policy T4 (Sustainable movement of goods and materials), Policy G1 (Delivery and location of growth), Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development), Policy A4 (Noise and Vibration), Policy CC4 (Air quality) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring), of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T3 (Transport capacity, connectivity and safeguarding), Policy T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and Policy T7 (Deliveries, servicing and construction) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 8 - In the absence of a Basement Impact Assessment to demonstrate otherwise, the proposed basement development would cause harm to the structural stability of the neighbouring properties and would adversely affect the structural, ground and water conditions of the area, contrary to Policy A5 (Basements) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy D10 (Basement development) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 9 - The proposed residential development (there is a lack of clarity about whether this is in fact part of the scheme) would fail to demonstrate compliance with energy and sustainability targets, contrary to Policy CC1 (Climate change mitigation) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy SI2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 10 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure the details set out on the sustainability and energy plans, a BREEAM pre-assessment and a carbon offset contribution, would be likely to contribute to climate change, contrary to Policy CC1 (Climate change mitigation), Policy CC2 (Adapting to climate change), Policy CC3 (Water and flooding), Policy CC4 (Air quality), Policy C1 (Health and wellbeing) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policies SI2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions), Policy SI3 (Energy infrastructure), Policy SI5 (Water infrastructure) and Policy SI1 (Improving air quality) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 11 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure financial contributions towards pedestrian, cyclist and environmental improvements, as well as public realm improvements in the area, would fail to mitigate the impact of the development created by increased trips, contrary to Policies T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T1 (Strategic approach to transport), Policy T2 (Healthy Streets) and Policy D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 12 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure financial contributions towards an electrical vehicle charging point, would fail to mitigate the increased pressure on existing infrastructure in the area, contrary to Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T6 (Car parking) and Policy SI1 (Improving air quality) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 13 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure financial contributions towards micro mobility improvements in the area, would fail to mitigate the impact of the development created by increased trips, contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T1 (Strategic approach to transport) and Policy T2 (Healthy Streets) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 14 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement securing a local employment and training package including an appropriate financial contribution, would be likely to lead to the exacerbation of local skill shortages and lack of training opportunities and would fail to contribute to the regeneration of the area, contrary to Policy G1 (Delivery and location of growth), Policy E1 (Economic development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy E11 (Skills and opportunities for all) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 15 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure a Construction Management Plan, construction impact bond and a financial contribution for construction management plan monitoring, would be likely to give rise to conflicts with other road users and be detrimental to the amenities of the area generally, contrary to Policy G1 (Delivery and location of growth), Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development), Policy T3 (Transport Infrastructure), Policy T4 (Sustainable movement of goods and materials), Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring), Policy A4 (Noise and Vibration) and Policy CC4 (Air quality) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T3 (Transport capacity, connectivity and safeguarding), Policy T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts), Policy T7 (Deliveries, servicing and construction) and Policy SI1 (Improving air quality) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 16 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure financial contributions towards open space, would fail to mitigate the increased demand for public open space in the area, contrary to Policy A2 (Open space) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy G4 (Open space) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 17 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure financial contributions towards the CA-R(a) CPZ review, would fail to mitigate the increased pressure on parking in the area, contrary to Policy T2 (Parking and car-free development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy T2 (Healthy Streets) and Policy T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 18 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement securing affordable workspace, would fail to spread economic opportunity more widely, contrary to Policy G1 (Delivery and location of growth), Policy E1 (Economic development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy E3 (Affordable workspace) of the London Plan 2021.
Reason : 19 - The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement securing a local employment and training package including an appropriate financial contribution, would be likely to lead to the exacerbation of local skill shortages and lack of training opportunities and would fail to contribute to the regeneration of the area, contrary to Policy G1 (Delivery and location of growth), Policy E1 (Economic development) and Policy DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy E11 (Skills and opportunities for all) of the London Plan 2021.
description: The erection of three floors of commercial floorspace (Use Class Eg), together with cycle parking, and associated works.
